features.name: post_created_timestamp
features.definition: What is the original post's creation Unix timestamp (later = later in the dataset period)?
features.spec: df['post_created_utc'] cast to float; null if missing or non-numeric. Units: Unix seconds.

h0: post_created_timestamp has no association with the likelihood of view change (delta).
h1: Higher post_created_timestamp (later posts) is associated with a higher likelihood of view change.
note: Linear association assumed; timestamp in raw Unix seconds so the coefficient is per second (rescaling would not change sign or significance). The sample is a balanced 1,000 changed/1,000 unchanged set, so it shows association within this sample only, not the true base rate or a causal effect. The dataset period is taken as the span of the supplied timestamps.
